Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(req: _req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
